result.brief: Pythia 提出多模态时间序列基础世界模型，用联合嵌入预测架构学习上下文条件潜动态，并将预测表征学习与概率解码解耦。
result.reason: Joint-embedding predictive architecture learns context-conditioned latent dynamics with multimodal context, contributing a reusable predictive representation—directly aligned with JEPA-style representation learning and world models.
